notes: Two-camera block starts now use sustained peaks, not one-frame maxes — the single-camera engine fixed this in v3.8.0/v3.9.0 but the two-camera port still took the max, so one glitched frame could inflate the reported rear-leg extension or tank the projection score and crown the wrong headline fix. A real extension or lean held across frames still reports; one wobbly frame no longer moves the number.
